source.title: Benign tumors and tumorlike conditions of the lung.

whyItFits: Open review of benign lung tumors as a class, covering epithelial and mesenchymal lesions including papilloma and hamartoma.
limitations: Open class review (Archives of Pathology & Laboratory Medicine, 2008). The 2025 Current Opinion review was not open and was not stored. Fleischner nodule guidance and single hamartoma case reports were not used.
